<bookmark mark='m2'/>The circles grow together with the base, so size does not matter.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>We should test with a letter instead.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A length is always less than two of the same length.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That is why three equal sides always make a triangle.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Try it on a side of six.
